## Developer Tools

- [Gemini Mcp 38d14e](https://awesome-mcp.com/en/servers/gemini-mcp-38d14e) - Google Gemini MCP - Use Google's visual, video and chat capabilities in your AI Assistant\. 14 tools, with setup config for Claude, Cursor and VS Code\. [Source](https://github.com/houtini-ai/gemini-mcp).
- [Legivel](https://awesome-mcp.com/en/servers/legivel) - Markdown or saved templates in, typeset PDF out: tables, math, diagrams\. 100 free documents a month\. Setup config for Claude, Cursor and VS Code\. [Source](https://github.com/mcp-community/legivel).
- [Postbye](https://awesome-mcp.com/en/servers/postbye) - Postbye MCP server: cancellation letters, mailing addresses and how-to-cancel guides for 8,600\+ companies\. Setup config for Claude, Cursor and VS Code\. [Source](https://github.com/postbye-team/postbye-mcp).
- [Singapore Proxy 89a96b](https://awesome-mcp.com/en/servers/singapore-proxy-89a96b) - A hosted MCP server that lets your AI agent browse the web as if it were on a Singapore mobile network\. Setup config for Claude, Cursor and VS Code\. [Source](https://github.com/Xavierfok/singapore-proxy-mcp).
- [Xhostd](https://awesome-mcp.com/en/servers/xhostd) - Agent-first hosting\. From Claude, Cursor, or Codex, your agent can create an app, push code, and deploy it to a live HTTPS URL, with managed… Setup config for Claude, Cursor and VS Code\. [Source](https://github.com/xhostd/xhostd-sdk).

## Search & Web

- [Datacircle](https://awesome-mcp.com/en/servers/datacircle) - Find the best GTM APIs\. Our MCP server is open to anyone, with no key: add api\.datacircle\.dev/mcp to Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor\. It answers from the sheet\. list\_apis lists the GTM APIs on it, and search\_plans finds their plans by API, provider or price\. [Source](https://github.com/waynehamadi/datacircle).

## Contributing

Add one structured JSON file under `data/servers/` and open a pull request. CI validates bounded metadata and canonical identities; maintainers review proposals before merging.

A merged catalog proposal is not proof of a working installation, official ownership, interface review or measured popularity. Website synchronization requires the reviewed import job; merging alone does not overwrite production data.
